verdict.rationale: Featurebase publishes a developer portal with a full HTTP and SDK API reference. It documents concrete REST endpoints such as listing feedback posts, a Reports API, a Training Data API, and a find/replace help-center edit endpoint explicitly aimed at AI agents, and it exposes an llms.txt. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and documented authentication and rate-limit details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Looking for the full HTTP and SDK reference? Switch to the API Reference tab in the top navigation.
POST /v2/help_center/articles/{id}/edit_body, a find/replace endpoint for surgical, byte-stable edits – ideal for AI agents renaming a product across many articles.
Returns all posts (feedback submissions) for the authenticated organization.
The Reports API exposes the same analytics engine that powers the Reports section of the Featurebase dashboard.
The Training Data API manages the knowledge available to your customer-support AI agent.
